text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to stop by a roadside 
café with Curren Bouquetd'or, we ran into 
Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Good day to you!! Ms. Bouquet! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Kawakami-san. Fufu, what a 
coincidence running into you here.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! This cafe is actually doing a 
collab with PreFai right now!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If you order from the collab menu, you 
even get a mini PreFie tiara! As a fan, 
there's simply no way I can pass this up~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! For my order, of course, the 
Pre-Fi Magic Circle Chocolat is the only 
choice!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Understood. However, there is only one 
bonus mini-tiara left... Will the rest of 
your party be alright with that?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes... We'll stick to the regular menu—

text_block_list.name: Excited Girl
text_block_list.text:
PriFai! PriFai! Mom, hurry up and order 
it!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, yes, yes. You were really looking 
forward to the merch, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —Nuuuuun!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That order just now was a princess feint! 
I shall take the extra-large parfait here!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
............ Are you sure about this, 
Kawakami-san...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
What?! A princess never goes back on her 
word!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Kawakami-san... are you okay...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Kh, that was just a princess breath of 
determination! I am com~pletely, perfectly 
all right, you see!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...... Could you come with me for a 
moment?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Look at this floral extravaganza! 
So pretty...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. ...Please wait just a little 
while, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—with practiced ease, Curren 
Bouquetd'or wove a splendid flower crown.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Th-This is... a tiara?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...Kawakami-san showed me such incredible 
warmth in her heart."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if this can replace a PreFie 
tiara, but... if nothing else, I wanted to 
bring a little warmth to your heart...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Thank you so much! With this, I am now 
in Purify Flower Form!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...Kawakami-san is running all over the 
place, isn't she? Hehe."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Because when someone did the same 
for me... —it made me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Young Bouquet
text_block_list.text:
"...Do you want cotton candy? I'll give 
you... mine."

text_block_list.name: Bouquet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Bouquet-chan is always sharing 
with others, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Just a short walk from our house, there 
was a wonderful flower garden. Mother 
would take me there often.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And so, one day— they made a flower crown 
for me.

text_block_list.name: Bouquet's Mother
text_block_list.text: This is a special treat for Bouquet-chan.

text_block_list.name: Bouquet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...I always notice, you know. The kindness 
you show me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...Being able to do something for someone 
else is true happiness."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
But... when I heard those words from my 
mother— it felt as though a gentle sun was 
shining down on me —that's how it felt.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes... That was harmony of the heart.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I want to be someone who can provide that, 
too. To the kind, to those trying their 
best, to the hurt—to everyone... just like 
a mother.
choice_data_list: I'm sure you've already become one.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
No... what I can do for others is 
really... quite limited.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Even so, if I can just fix it even a 
little bit...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... That sounds just like something 
Kawakami-san would say.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
“Still... looking at that person, I can 
tell. Strong, warm... Someone with a 
kindness like the sun.”
